svg.title: Pointwise and uniform convergence of powers
svg.desc: Left: x to the n for n equal to 1, 2, 5, 11, and 30 on the unit interval. Its pointwise limit is zero below 1 and one at 1, and the supremum error remains one. The moving input 2 to the power negative one eleventh has error one half for n equal to 11. Right: on the interval from zero to 0.8, the same functions converge uniformly to zero. For n at least 11 all errors are less than 0.1.

g.text: Dashed black: the pointwise limit; open circles exclude an endpoint value.
